notes.title: Ergastulum - Development Update
notes.content:
Ergastulum development is still going strong! Please add the game to your [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/598430/Ergastulum/]Wishlist[/url] for the latest development updates :)

A lot of changes have happened recently and I wanted to share some of the latest additions to the game.

Most recently, I have started to work on the traps found in the dungeons and will be a re-imagination of what I did in Dungeon Nightmares II.

[b]Pendulums[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4aErmdW.png[/img]

[b]A Close Shave[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sIZaz5MO4FQ

[b]Crushers[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cpgNrdE.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.content:
Options are now available on the Main Menu.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added mouse invert option for both vertical and horizontal
[*]Added mouse sensitivity
[*]Added game pad sensitivity
[*]Added V-Sync toggle
[*]Fixed a minor trap bug
[/list]
